subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers close this superseded, conflicting macOS onboarding PR, or sponsor a narrow rebase/cherry-pick despite the security and auth blockers?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and the remaining choice mixes product direction, branch supersession, and security/auth merge risk that automation should not decide.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and keep the merged macOS Gateway setup plus Crestodian onboarding work as canonical.

options.title: Rebase and narrow
options.body: Ask for a fresh branch on current main that preserves only still-needed UI work and fixes the credentialed probe, acknowledgement bypass, and auth-upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep for remote UX discussion
options.body: Leave this PR open only as historical context while remote Gateway UX direction stays in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90665.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and keep the merged macOS Gateway setup plus Crestodian onboarding work as canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged macOS setup and Crestodian onboarding work that most directly supersedes this branch.
